set_videos_store: set the in-memory video store with a dictionary of video IDs mapped to Video objects
get_videos_store: get all videos currently stored in the in-memory video store as a dictionary
review_store_module: review the in-memory video store module that manages a global dictionary of Video objects
summarize_set_videos: summarize the set_videos function that replaces the global ALL_VIDEOS dictionary with new video data
summarize_get_videos: summarize the get_videos function that returns the current global ALL_VIDEOS dictionary
